id: What We Do in the Shadows (2014)
title: What We Do in the Shadows
about: Vampire flatmates in Wellington deal with chores, rivals and a new recruit.
cue: Serve the hot chips when Nick tries to eat one.
faces: Serve the hot chips when Nick tries to eat one.
Welcome to our flat. Please lay down a towel before you eat, these couches are very old and very nice.
Thick double-fried chips served with garlic mayo.
Roasted beetroot, goat's cheese and blood orange on toasted baguette.
Black pudding with mash and onion gravy
Chocolate sponge, morello cherries, whipped cream and dark chocolate.
Fresh blood orange juice topped with soda water over ice.
Werewolves, not swearwolves, so pour politely.
Serves everyone on the couch. Photos: TMDB.
